coverage.scope: Opt-in workflow metadata only; no employee ranking, external telemetry or proven causal savings.
limitations: Self-selected workflow episodes may be biased or describe unequal work. No causal benefit or employee ranking is established.
All selected episodes, including failures and retries, contribute; elapsed runtime is not human labor. Gross/net savings compare cohort means counterfactually.
Frequency describes retained selected episodes within the explicit window, not a measured external arrival rate. Retention pruning is explicit; expired samples are excluded.
Small samples: fewer than five episodes in at least one cohort; do not treat the difference as a stable benefit estimate.
Some durations or declared costs are estimates; measured and estimated input counts remain separate.
Some runtime, retry or intervention metadata is unknown; known-value means do not fill unknown values with zero.
Projected savings are estimates at operator-declared future volume and horizon, subtracting the same stated build, maintenance and incident costs once.
